definitions.explanation: A person of high social rank or birth, belonging to the aristocracy. In Japanese history, refers to court nobles (kuge) and the privileged class that existed until the modern era.

examples.japanese: {貴族|きぞく}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{生活|せいかつ}→生活：01443_seikatsu⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{豪華|ごうか}→豪華：02815_gouka⟧だった。
examples.english: The lives of the aristocrats were luxurious.

examples.japanese: ⟦{平安|へいあん}→平安：12641_heian⟧⟦{時代|じだい}→時代：01424_jidai⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{貴族|きぞく}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{和歌|わか}→和歌：05230_waka⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{詠|よ}んだ→詠む：14186_yomu⟧。
examples.english: Aristocrats of the Heian period composed waka poetry.

examples.japanese: ⟦ヨーロッパ→ヨーロッパ：00427_yooroppa⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{貴族|きぞく}⟦{階級|かいきゅう}→階級：05515_kaikyuu⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{長|なが}い→長い：00491_nagai⟧⟦{歴史|れきし}→歴史：02267_rekishi⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{持|も}っている→持つ：00478_motsu⟧。
examples.english: The aristocratic class in Europe has a long history.

notes:
USAGE:
Refers to the aristocratic class in both Japanese and Western history. In Japanese history, {貴族|きぞく} most commonly refers to the court nobles (⟦{公家|くげ}→公家：12664_kuge⟧) of the Heian period who wielded political and cultural influence.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {貴族|きぞく}⟦{階級|かいきゅう}→階級：05515_kaikyuu⟧ (aristocratic class)
- {貴族|きぞく}⟦{社会|しゃかい}→社会：01427_shakai⟧ (aristocratic society)
- {貴族|きぞく}{院|いん} (House of Peers — historical)
- {貴族|きぞく}{的|てき}な (aristocratic, noble-like)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{公家|くげ}→公家：12664_kuge⟧: specifically Japanese court nobles
- ⟦{武士|ぶし}→武士：03989_bushi⟧: samurai — the warrior class, distinct from the court nobility
